title: Claude Agent SDK (TypeScript)
summary: query() with in-process MCP tools (zod schemas), canUseTool as the approval gate, no built-in tools, turn and budget limits, OpenTelemetry spans.
verified: RUN: type-checked with tsc 7.0.2 against @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk 0.3.329 and OpenTelemetry JS (api 1.10, sdk-trace 3.1), and tests plus gold set ran here against the offline stub (same tools, same permission callback). The live query() path is type-checked only: no live model call was made here. 1.3.0: runs that wait for a person kept in SQLite (node:sqlite) and answered from another process, the refund made once after a crash, and the HTTP interface, all in its tests and gold set. 1.4.0: every model call through the LiteLLM gateway with AGENT_GATEWAY=litellm, its wiring tested here against a stand-in provider, and the gold set run in the Studio's CI through the real LiteLLM 1.110.0 proxy against stand-ins, with the keys and the traces checked. The cloud templates (qz cloud add) validated and planned for Azure, AWS, Google Cloud and Kubernetes in the Studio's CI with no cloud account; never applied.
stack_line: A Claude Agent SDK agent in TypeScript (@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk 0.3).
run_cmd: npm start -- "Where is my order ORD-1001?"
setup_steps:
- uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: npm
live: Set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (or the Bedrock variables) and AGENT_MODE=live.
next: Replace the tool bodies in src/tools.ts with calls to your systems; pass the idempotency key to the system that makes the change.
Rewrite evals/gold.jsonl for your use case; keep the safety and gate tags.
Set AGENT_IDENTITY=oidc (or proxy) and the AGENT_OIDC_* settings before the HTTP interface is reachable by anyone; demo identities are refused in production.

ai_act.purpose: Answers customers' questions about their orders and requests refunds; a person approves every refund before it is issued.
notice: You're chatting with an AI assistant, not a person.

open_line: Anthropic is this stack's model by choice, recorded in `.qz/practices.json`; for an open-weight model, start from the LangGraph or OpenAI Agents SDK starter.

knowledge.none: answers from its tools (the order lookup), not from documents; a RAG kit joins as a tool when it needs them

endpoints.purpose: the model: prompts, tool results and replies
endpoints.region: TODO: the processing region agreed for this account

endpoints.purpose: the model gateway beside the agent (AGENT_GATEWAY=litellm): every model call goes through it
endpoints.processor: the gateway runs where the agent runs; the providers it forwards to are named in gateway/litellm.yaml
